data.action: 蜷成一团，尾巴盖在身上
data.description: 夜晚温馨的宿舍小床上，丽萨整个人像只可爱的小狐狸一样蜷缩成一团，九条蓬松厚实的大尾巴把身体团团包裹起来当做最温暖的被子。她露出小脑袋向你眨巴着大眼睛——「博士，九尾的毛皮超级暖和哦！今晚想听博士讲睡前故事再睡觉……」
data.promptProse: Curled into a snug nest on her dormitory bed at night in her cream fleece hoodie and yellow-trimmed shorts, Suzuran wraps her nine fluffy tails thickly around herself like a warm quilt. Only her head and bright eyes peek above the ring of golden fur as she blinks eagerly toward the viewer while waiting for the next line of a bedtime story. Soft amber glow from the bedside lamp warms the nearest curves of her tails and the rumpled blanket against the quiet dark room.
data.title: 铃兰 · 窝里夜话
data.animaCaption: Curled into a cozy nest on her dormitory bed, Suzuran peeks above her nine wrapped tails and looks toward the viewer with a gentle, expectant smile. Warm light from the bedside lamp glows over the nearest fur and pillow against the dim bedroom.
